source_review: New discovery classes retain immutable complete source objects; IsFor is reference affinity, not authentication or stored content-hash identity.
Transport discovery copies the exact prior pending/due/order predicate. Existing equality/next-boundary, continuation callback, hold and per-stage physical rules remain in place.
Gathering discovery uses the same strongest admitted tool and full-cycle stock predicate. It reports ineligible due occurrences without regrowing them.
RegrowNodes applies to source.Nodes in original canonical order via unchanged Regrow. Exact-step and elapsed recovery retain their clock guards and actor recovery arithmetic.

Only due nodes calculate the tool maximum now. Constructor admission guarantees a matching tool; bounded MaxSwings/uint power makes this multiplication representable. Invalid-owner construction is not newly allowed.

The host fixture uses existing lawful profile9 with both owners; cancellation executes before transport, and gathering/exposure still advance once. This is not simultaneous regrowth/delivery or current40/41 partial loading.
Shared StorageFiles adds only opt-in directory retention; default cleanup unchanged. Tests run with an explicit fresh retained root.
